description: Header file defining memory management functions for the bbf context, including allocation, deallocation, string duplication, and memory resizing, with macros for dynamic memory operations.

methods.name: dmfree
methods.description: Frees memory pointed to by the argument.

methods.name: __dminitmem
methods.description: Initializes memory management with a list.

methods.name: __dmcleanmem
methods.description: Cleans up memory management with a list.

methods.name: __dmmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of a given size and associates it with a list.

methods.name: __dmcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array.

methods.name: __dmstrdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string and associates it with a list.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_mem
methods.description: Initializes memory management for a given context.

methods.name: bbfdm_clean_mem
methods.description: Cleans up memory management for a given context.

methods.name: bbfdm_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for a context.

methods.name: bbfdm_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string within a context.

methods.name: bbfdm_asprintf
methods.description: Allocates formatted string within a context.
